entities.summary: Oluwaseun Ayodeji Osowobi is a Nigerian women's rights activist. She is the founder of the Stand to End Rape (STER) Initiative. In 2019 she was the second Nigerian woman to be named to Time 100 Next list, and she was the Commonwealth Young Person of the Year for that same year.
